$comment: Copy to your project root as tokens.config.json. All paths are relative to this file.

figma.$comment: fileKey is the segment after /design/ in the Figma URL.

mcp.$comment: Node ids to run get_variable_defs against. Coverage is per-node, so list every frame that together binds all tokens (usually the Foundations pages).

rest.$comment: Fallback path. `styles` reads published FILL/TEXT styles. `scrape` is only for files that document tokens as canvas artefacts.

layers.$comment: Optional. Maps token-name globs to the layers of the design system, usually mirroring the Figma variable collections (1. Primitive / 2. Alias / 3. Semantic). First match wins, so list the most specific first. Run `node scripts/verify.mjs` to see which namespaces actually exist before writing these.

targets.$comment: Omit `layers` to export everything. A product app usually wants only the semantic layer.

targets.$comment4: Tailwind: the MAJOR version, not a boolean. 4 appends @theme blocks to tokens.css; 3 writes tokens.tailwind.cjs to spread into theme.extend. Emitting the wrong major produces no utilities and no error, so this is refused rather than guessed. Omit it for a project that does not use Tailwind.
targets.$comment5: How a colour with alpha is spelled: "rgb" (default, CSS Color 4) or "hex" (8-digit). Use "hex" when adopting the pipeline in a project whose CSS is already written that way, so the first diff shows only real changes.
targets.$comment3: Optional. Omit `modes` to emit every mode in tokens.json. modeSelectors overrides the default :root[data-theme="<mode>"] selector per mode.
targets.$comment2: Optional. Rebuilds the semantic → primitive references that extraction flattens, so a theme can override one primitive and every semantic token follows. Links are inferred by matching values: ambiguous ones stay literals and are reported. Check `verify.mjs` prints a near-100% link rate before turning `strict` on. Remove this block to keep flat literals. See references/alias-linking.md.
